title: GitHub - 50YearsPhone/vision-50-years-phone
excerpt: Contribute to 50YearsPhone/vision-50-years-phone development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
Make your old Android phone faster and healthier over time — instead of slower.

No root. No new hardware. 20-minute install. Open source.

What it does

  • Monitors battery, storage, thermal, and RAM health every night
  • Clears junk caches automatically (with your confirmation)
  • Speeds up the interface on older phones
  • Warns you before storage or heat becomes a problem
  • All processing stays on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.

Install (Android 10+, no root)

  1. Install Termux and Termux:API from F-Droid
  2. Enable Developer Options (Settings > About Phone > tap Build Number 7x) and Wireless Debugging
  3. In Termux, run: 
    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/50YearsPhone/vision-50-years-phone/main/install.sh | bash

Why

Phones don't wear out. Software bloat, runaway background apps, and battery aging make them feel slow. This fixes the software side — and keeps your phone useful for years longer.

Status

Phase 1 (early). Tested on: [Galaxy S8+]. Contributions welcome — especially device profiles and battery data.

License

MIT

安装（Android 10+，无需root）

  1. 从 F-Droid 安装 Termux 和 Termux:API
  2. 启用开发者选项（设置 > 关于手机 > 点击内部版本号 7x）和无线调试
  3. 在 Termux 中，运行：curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/50YearsPhone/vision-50-years-phone/main/install.sh |巴什

Why

手机不会磨损。 软件膨胀、后台应用程序失控和电池老化让它们感觉很慢。 这修复了软件方面的问题，并使您的手机可以使用更长的时间。

地位

第一阶段（早期）。 测试设备：[Galaxy S8+]。 欢迎贡献——尤其是设备配置文件和电池数据。
